summary.name: Infinite Zoom (Motion Design and Cinematography). This is an explicit camera and transition technique, not an art movement.
summary.visualIdentity: Explicit: connected worlds or scales in which the next scene already exists within a visible object, lens, or portal. A continuous zoom path aligns transitions as the portal fills the frame. Focus, scale, and velocity must match, and loops must connect composition and motion.
summary.suitableUses: Explicit good fits: psychedelic and demoscene imagery, infinite zoom and kaleidoscopic transitions, and surreal or abstract spatial passages. Inferred from companion guidance: looping brand journeys and educational scale tours. Dense reading during travel is not suited.
summary.limitations: Adapt or omit when viewers must read dense text during travel, when an unplanned hidden reset would break a one-shot requirement, or when the topic needs stable orientation or reduced motion. Raster textures blur when magnified. Detail density should not vary wildly between levels.
summary.palette: No canonical palette is defined. The optional example, used only when no approved palette is supplied, is background #F4EFE3, foreground #30404A, accent_1 #688D96, and accent_2 #B78462. Gradients are disabled. Foreground on background measures 9.348:1. Accent pairings fail normal-text targets and are decorative only. Contrast checks cover two colors only, so composited frames must be rechecked. Task colors override this example.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Video uses a keyed, time-based camera advance through each level, with aligned handoffs and a loop seam that matches composition and velocity. Interactive output may map scroll or arrow keys to levels, with pause and reduced-motion jump cuts, per the companion guidance. Optional motion references are 002 vortex passage, 005 gateway approach with mist, 012 chapter handoff, 015 story steps, and 019 dolly. Motion 019 needs real depth or a disclosed 2.5D approximation. Exact easing and durations are unspecified.
summary.audio: Audio is unspecified by the style. Suggestions depend on topic and audience: optional music, narration, restrained accents, ambience, or silence. Do not attach mandatory sound or let it compete with narration. Honor explicit user audio requirements first. Verify speech intelligibility, balance, and picture sync in the final output.
summary.assetRequirements: Layered assets should have alpha, consistent dimensions, and clear naming, or use numbered frame sequences with a layer manifest. Inspect assets before composition. Prefer vector or high-resolution art, because raster detail blurs under magnification. Prepare mist layers and load local fonts before rendering. No specific asset list is defined for this style.
summary.combinations: Style-027 supplies scalable vector contour art in slate with blue-grey and tan accents. Keep line-weight hierarchy consistent and reserve the accent for the next portal only. Style-097 adds a fixed annotation layer for scale labels and units, kept outside the zoom in a stable 2D layer. Infinite Zoom stands alone when nested worlds are the content.
summary.productionApproach: HyperFrames is the default composition and export pipeline. Remotion is a fallback only when HyperFrames is unavailable or a verified limitation exists, and the reason must be recorded. An existing React project is not a valid reason. Canvas 2D renders the levels, with optional PixiJS on a private ticker and explicit render on each seek. A paused GSAP timeline owns motion. Verify seeks, key frames, loop seams, and audio sync before delivery.
